items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1963-03-29
items.q: Ray Allen and Guy Kelly, when he was playing with his dance band, Walter Pichon was playing mellow for him with them.

ctx.x: Did they have, did they have Tom Brass band?

Yes, indeed. When Allen and them hit the street, when Ray Allen and them hit the street, I mean, Ray Allen and Guy Kelly, when he was playing with his dance band, Walter Pichon was playing mellow for him with them. When they hit the street, probably didn't roll up. I'm telling you.
And them bands used to advertise on them trucks.

items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: but Walter Pichon was class, more class

ctx.x: Baby Bruce they call him. Yeah, I'll make a note here too. Well Lil' Willie was one of them good piano players around there too. You see, just like I tell you, in them days, a boy like Lil' Willie, Baby Bruce, and they had nothing called Pruxum. I don't know his right name, but you know there's all good piano players around there, but Walter Pichon was class, more class. He could play the stuff they played and he was a musician on the boot of it. But he used to stand, boy, now on two Coca-Cola box then he'd be…
